description: This PHP class 'LocalizedDateFormatter' provides date formatting with localization support, including translation of day and month names, and caching of format strings.

classes.name: LocalizedDateFormatter
classes.description: A helper class for formatting dates with localization support, including translation of day and month names.

methods.name: formatDate
methods.description: Formats a DateTime object into a string based on the provided date format, applying localization replacements.

methods.name: getSearchAndReplaceParams
methods.description: Generates search and replace arrays for localization based on the date format string, with caching.

methods.name: getSearchReplaceTupleForShortDays
methods.description: Prepares search and replace arrays for short day names if the format includes the short day character.

methods.name: getSearchReplaceTupleForLongDays
methods.description: Prepares search and replace arrays for long day names if the format includes the long day character.

methods.name: getSearchReplaceTupleForShortMonth
methods.description: Prepares search and replace arrays for short month names if the format includes the short month character.

methods.name: getSearchReplaceTupleForLongMonth
methods.description: Prepares search and replace arrays for long month names if the format includes the long month character.
